description: This header file declares external API functions for the Value Name Mapper Object in the ANSC framework, including creation, removal, and initialization functions.

methods.name: AnscCreateValueNameMaper
methods.description: Creates a Value Name Mapper object with given container, owner, and reserve contexts.

methods.name: AnscVnmoCreate
methods.description: Creates a Value Name Mapper object with specified contexts.

methods.name: AnscVnmoRemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Value Name Mapper object.

methods.name: AnscVnmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls objects into the Value Name Mapper.

methods.name: AnscVnmoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Value Name Mapper object.
